faqs.question: How does admission to VIT work?
faqs.answer: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability. Register and complete the application: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP. Pay and upload the photograph: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph. Participate in counselling: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list. Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at VIT?
faqs.answer: 2026-27: Resident Indian; born on/after 1 July 2006; 60% overall and 60% in PCB, with published 10% relaxation for specified categories/regions; English required.

faqs.question: Which application documents does VIT list?
faqs.answer: Birth certificate or passport copy as age proof.; Class XII hall ticket.; Class XII mark statements for all attempts.; SC/ST community certificate where applicable.; Nativity certificate for the specified North-Eastern states or Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh categories.; JPG/JPEG photograph of20–300kB and scanned signature of5–150kB, following the portal dimensions.. Check the applicable notice for originals, formats and category-specific certificates.

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for VIT?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://admissions.vit.ac.in/bsc-hons-agri-2026-applications/login; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.

faqs.question: How can I contact VIT about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 0416-220 2656. Published email: dean.vaial@vit.ac.in. Official admissions: https://admissions.vit.ac.in/bsc-hons-agri-2026-applications/login

faqs.question: Is an entrance examination required for VIT agriculture in 2026?
faqs.answer: The dedicated 2026 portal explicitly says no entrance examination; selection uses qualifying-examination merit and counselling.

faqs.question: Are mathematics-only applicants eligible under the 2026 rules?
faqs.answer: The 2026 portal requires Physics, Chemistry and Biology; older prospectuses show different combinations. Use the current portal.

faqs.question: How does admission to VIT work?
faqs.answer: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability. Register and complete the application: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP. Pay and upload the photograph: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph. Participate in counselling: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list. Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

faqs.question: Is an entrance examination required for VIT agriculture in 2026?
faqs.answer: The dedicated 2026 portal explicitly says no entrance examination; selection uses qualifying-examination merit and counselling.

faqs.question: Are mathematics-only applicants eligible under the 2026 rules?
faqs.answer: The 2026 portal requires Physics, Chemistry and Biology; older prospectuses show different combinations. Use the current portal.

faqs.question: What is the application cost?
faqs.answer: The 2026 portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700.

faqs.question: Why are three tuition figures shown?
faqs.answer: VIT publishes annual tuition categories of INR 1,10,000, INR 1,95,000 and INR 2,25,000 for the 2026-27 intake.

faqs.question: Which campus offers the researched course?
faqs.answer: The dedicated application portal identifies the Vellore campus.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at VIT?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/vellore-institute-of-technology/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at VIT?
faqs.answer: 4 years. Agricultural science at the Vellore campus, taught through VAIAL with field, laboratory and outreach resources.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at VIT?
faqs.answer: 2026-27: Resident Indian; born on/after 1 July 2006; 60% overall and 60% in PCB, with published 10% relaxation for specified categories/regions; English required.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at VIT?
faqs.answer: ₹1,10,000 / year · 2026-27. Category 1 tuition. Category 2: INR 1,95,000; Category 3: INR 2,25,000 annually. One-time refundable caution deposit INR 5,000. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to VIT work?
faqs.answer: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability. Register and complete the application: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP. Pay and upload the photograph: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph. Participate in counselling: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list. Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for VIT?
faqs.answer: Vellore Institute of Technology: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2024-02-08 to 2029-02-07. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at VIT?
faqs.answer: VAIAL describes agricultural and horticultural land, teaching and research laboratories, gardens, composting units, irrigation and machinery. Its events list records farmer-facing training as well as student and research activities.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at VIT?
faqs.answer: Teaching and research laboratories: VAIAL identifies analytical instrumentation and multidisciplinary research laboratories. Botanical and medicinal gardens: Both gardens are named alongside farm and composting resources.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for VIT?
faqs.answer: VAIAL describes agricultural and horticultural land, teaching and research laboratories, gardens, composting units, irrigation and machinery. Its events list records farmer-facing training as well as student and research activities. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for VIT?
faqs.answer: An agriculture-specific scholarship and its current conditions have not yet been verified for this profile.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for VIT?
faqs.answer: A current agriculture-specific placement report was not available in the checked material.

faqs.answer: Published phone: 0416-220 2656. Published email: dean.vaial@vit.ac.in. Official admissions: https://admissions.vit.ac.in/bsc-hons-agri-2026-applications/login

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for VIT?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://admissions.vit.ac.in/bsc-hons-agri-2026-applications/login; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
